spec.headline: Containing Distress Before Capital Breaches Parity
spec.subhead: Step-by-step containment protocol preventing insolvency and rounding bias during severe collateral drawdowns.

blocks.text: Volatility Spike: Health factor compresses under unattended adverse price movement.
1.1x Boundary: Autonomous risk policies activate before collateral reaches parity.
Floor Division: mul_wad_down executes to prevent rounding in the protocol's favour.
Isolated Settlement: Distress is fully resolved without cross-margin contagion.

focal.reason: Floor division is the core mathematical guarantee preventing bias during liquidation.

defects.issue: Severe visual weight imbalance leaving the right canvas dead
defects.reason: All content is constrained to a narrow column anchored to the left, leaving massive dead space on the right and bottom that reads as an unfinished layout rather than intentional negative space.
defects.fix: Increase the max-width of the sequence text blocks from 720px to 900px, and increase the vertical padding between steps 01–04 from 24px to 36px to better utilize the square frame.

defects.issue: Focal step lacks sufficient visual distinction
defects.reason: The intended focal element relies solely on a subtle white-versus-gray text contrast switch among four sequential items, failing to instantly capture the eye as the core mechanical takeaway.
defects.fix: Enclose step 03 within a subtle dark surface card (e.g. 4% white fill with a 1px 12% white stroke) with 16px internal padding to decisively elevate it over adjacent steps.

defects.issue: Low text contrast on inactive sequence items
defects.reason: The muted body text for steps 01 and 04 drops below comfortable institutional legibility thresholds against the near-black background.
defects.fix: Increase the text opacity of steps 01, 02, and 04 body copy by 15% to maintain legibility while preserving hierarchy beneath step 03.
